description: Read a production domain's verification status: the overall status (complete or incomplete), the DNS status of each required CNAME record, the SSL status, and the mail and proxy status when they apply.

domain.description: The domain's name, such as example.com, or its ID (dmn_…), as list_domains returns them.

workspace.description: The workspace to act in, as its ID or name. A workspace is the Clerk Dashboard organization that owns the applications, not an Organization inside an application (those go in `organization_id` on the tools that have it). Only needed when this connection covers several workspaces; the error for a missing choice lists them.

name: get_domain_status
title: Get domain verification status
